system.description: You may use a Use the Force check in place of a Persuasion check when attempting to change the Attitude of an undomesticated creature with an Intelligence of 2 or less. Additionally, you do not take the normal -5 penalty on the check if the creature can't speak or understand your language.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Felucian Shamans
